Sporting de Hortaleza's bus was attacked upon its arrival in Tenerife for the Copa del Rey. A group of unidentified individuals threw stones at the Madrid side's vehicle before the match. Fortunately, no serious injuries were reported, although several windows of the coach were completely smashed. The players and coaching staff went through moments of great tension and had to take cover inside. Security forces arrived immediately to escort the team and launch an investigation aimed at identifying the attackers.
